panel.title: Tools
panel.description: Select an area, process it, then inspect and export the results.

aoi.title: Select AOI
aoi.empty: No saved area of interest to restore.

process.title: Process
process.description: Derives two layers from the AOI and publishes a legend for each.

layers.title: Layers
layers.description: Add a standalone demo layer or a PMTiles vector layer, or clear the map and its legends. Both show up in the layer control, top right.

export.title: Export
export.description: Send the AOI or a processed output to Earth Engine, Drive or SEPAL.
